mapping_rules: Match headers case-insensitively after trimming Unicode whitespace, but preserve the original header.
Never map solely by column position.
Validate file grain, report type/version, units, timezone, currency, and sign before calculations.
When two source fields target one normalized field, define precedence and retain both source values in metadata.
When one source row contains multiple economic components, split it into child normalized records with parent_transaction_id.
Unknown or conflicting columns remain unmapped and enter the data-gap report; do not guess material fields.

unknown_column.action: Preserve original header and value in a sidecar/unmapped-fields structure; set mapping confidence to unable_to_determine; exclude from calculations.

unknown_amount_column.action: Do not infer gross, fee, tax, refund, reserve, financing, payout, or deposit meaning from numeric format alone.

ambiguous_identifier.action: Retain as source_record_id candidate; do not overwrite order, settlement, payout, or bank IDs without evidence.

ambiguous_date.action: Preserve raw date and require semantic type plus timezone before reconciliation.

ambiguous_sign.action: Preserve source_amount and leave normalized_amount null until direction is supported.

multiple_currency_file.action: Partition by currency before aggregation; convert only with documented rate, quote, and source.
